title: Channel-native Fisher surrogate (c15) + covariance chain (c8-c15)

inputs.name: CAMB theory spectra
inputs.locator: generated via c13 script (CAMB Boltzmann code)

inputs.name: Heinrich et al. 2023 SPHEREx covariance (Cov_B)
inputs.locator: not publicly released by original authors — DP2-26/DP2-29 gap

environment.python: requirements.txt (repo root: numpy, scipy, astropy, sympy-adjacent research deps) + CAMB

original_run.wall_clock: hours-scale (CAMB calls, exact per-script wall-clock not logged)

reproduction.notes: Surrogate chain is runnable-now on local CPU; the true survey covariance (Cov_B) is external-data-gated — Heinrich et al. 2023 SPHEREx covariance was never publicly released.

verification: Re-run and confirm the nuisance ladder 3.5-sigma/3.1-sigma/2.3-sigma/0.4-sigma reproduces to numeric tolerance (<1% relative); true-covariance closure requires the gated Cov_B and is out of scope for this reproduction.
